title: Kestrel Fly & Drive Travel Allowance Schedule (Delivery & Pickup Appointments)
content:
Travel to the hub is reimbursed only under the Kestrel Fly & Drive method of Delivery & Pickup Appointments. The schedule below lists every fulfillment method, so that the allowance figure for any appointment can be read off directly.

| Fulfillment method | Airfare cap (buyer's one-way flight to the hub) | Rideshare or taxi cap (arrival airport to the hub) | Hotel cap (one night, when the flight lands after 18:00 local time) | Minimum distance from the buyer's residential ZIP to the hub | Receipts submitted within, after the completed pickup | Reimbursement paid within, after a receipt is accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 miles | 0 calendar days | 0 business days |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 miles | 0 calendar days | 0 business days |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | $500.00 | $75.00 | $150.00 | 250 miles | 30 calendar days | 10 business days |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 miles | 0 calendar days | 0 business days |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 miles | 0 calendar days | 0 business days |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 miles | 0 calendar days | 0 business days |

### The Fly & Drive figures in words

- **Airfare**: up to $500.00 for the buyer's one-way flight to the hub.
- **Rideshare or taxi**: up to $75.00 for the fare from the arrival airport to the hub.
- **Hotel**: up to $150.00 for one night, when the flight lands after 18:00 local time.
- **Distance**: the minimum distance from the buyer's residential ZIP to the hub for travel reimbursement is 250 miles.
- **Receipts**: submitted within 30 calendar days after the completed pickup.
- **Payment**: made within 10 business days after a receipt is accepted.

All other methods carry $0.00 caps and zero periods.
